definition.title: What is a virtual guestbook?
definition.body: A virtual guestbook is a browser-based app where wedding guests add photos, videos and wishes after scanning a QR code — no account and nothing to install. Everything lands in one gallery at original quality, and after the wedding you download it all in one go.

1.question: Can I buy the guestbook in advance and keep the promotional price?
1.answer: Yes! Once you purchase, your price is locked in. You can set up your guestbook whenever you're ready.

2.question: Can I download photos and videos later?
2.answer: Absolutely. Depending on your plan, you have {minDownloadDays}–{maxDownloadDays} days after the wedding to download all content.

3.question: Can guests see the gallery?
3.answer: Yes. The gallery is visible to all guests who join via QR code. They can view and add their own photos.

4.question: Is there a limit on photos and videos guests can upload?
4.answer: Each package has a storage pool — from {minStorage} to {maxStorage}, depending on the plan you pick.

5.question: Can guests upload after the wedding?
5.answer: Yes. Guests can add photos during the access period ({minGuestAccessDays}–{maxGuestAccessDays} days depending on plan) from the wedding date.

aboutPage.heading: About Wirtualna Księga Gości
aboutPage.lead: Wirtualna Księga Gości is a web app where wedding guests add photos, videos and wishes after scanning a QR code — with nothing to install and no account to create.
aboutPage.whyBody: After every wedding the same thing happens: the best shots sit on guests' phones, and collecting them takes weeks of asking and scrolling through chats. We wanted a QR code on the table to be enough.
aboutPage.howBody: Guest uploads reach our server at the quality they were sent in. The couple decides what stays in the gallery and downloads everything after the wedding, within the window their package allows.

guestbookPage.heading: A virtual wedding guestbook — how it works and is it worth it?
guestbookPage.lead: A traditional guestbook has its charm, but it often ends up as a handful of signatures and a short "all the best". A virtual guestbook works differently: it collects real memories — photos, videos and messages from guests — exactly when they happen.
guestbookPage.whatIsBody: It is a page running in the browser that guests join through a link or a QR code. They can add a photo or video from their phone, write a message and browse the gallery of memories. Most importantly: nothing to install and no account to create. A guest scans the code with their camera and can start straight away.

1.title: You create the guestbook
1.description: Pick a package and set up a guestbook for your wedding.

2.title: You get a QR code
2.description: Share the code with guests — on table cards, a poster at the entrance or on a screen.

3.title: Guests add content
3.description: During the wedding they upload photos, short videos and wishes straight from their phones.

4.title: You download the memories
4.description: After the wedding you download everything at the quality it was captured in.

guestbookPage.whyTitle: Why couples choose the online version

1.title: Photos from everyone, not just the photographer
1.description: Guests capture plenty of moments from the side: preparations, the dance floor, funny moments at the table. The gallery collects all of it in one place.

2.title: Everything happens immediately
2.description: You do not have to ask for photos after the wedding. Guests upload them during the party, while they are still fresh on their phones.

3.title: Easier for guests
3.description: A QR code and a browser are the lowest possible barrier — including for people who dislike installing apps.

4.title: Order and easy downloads
4.description: Instead of a dozen chats and cloud links you get one gallery you download in a single go.

guestbookPage.planBody: The packages differ in how much you can customise, how long guests keep access and how much time you have to download. Basic is enough if you simply want to collect photos. Silver adds custom styling and the wedding schedule. Gold is the full set with video and printed QR table cards.

1.question: Do guests need to create an account?
1.answer: No. A guest opens the QR code or link and can add a photo right away. There is no sign-up and no login.

2.question: Can we download everything after the wedding?
2.answer: Yes. Depending on the package you have between {minDownloadDays} and {maxDownloadDays} days after the wedding to download photos and videos.

3.question: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
3.answer: Yes. All you need is a browser and a camera to scan the QR code — the guestbook opens like any other website.

basic.intro: The Basic package is the classic version of the virtual guestbook. Guests scan a QR code, add photos and wishes, and you get everything in a single gallery — with no app to install and no accounts to create.
basic.forWhom: A good fit if you simply want to collect guest photos and do not need custom styling or the wedding schedule inside the app.

silver.intro: The Silver package is the most popular version. On top of the photo gallery you get custom styling — colour, photo and font — plus a wedding schedule your guests can check on their phones.
silver.forWhom: For couples who want the guestbook to match the rest of the wedding styling, and who want guests to know what happens when.

gold.intro: The Gold package is the full set: a photo and video gallery, the longest guest access, {downloadDays} days to download everything and {qrTableCards} printed QR table cards. It also includes the Find Your Table feature.
gold.forWhom: For larger weddings and couples who want short videos as well as photos, without preparing print material themselves.
